The '''Valera uprising''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Valera]]. The world was the site of an uprising against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. For his first assignment aboard the ''[[Stalker/Legends|Stalker]]'', [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Akal Zed]] was tasked to suppress the rebellion. Zed managed to wipe out the rebels despite a flawed battle plan. The Empire lost several support ships in the battle, and Captain Zed was considered responsible for these casualties. He was later transferred with his ship in the [[Elrood Sector Fleet]] as punishment.<ref name="PotG3" />
